proposed.title: Evidence Ladder for Literature Review
proposed.summary: A short guided activity that helps students separate strong mathematical sources from weaker background references before they write a project plan.
proposed.excerpt: Learners compare four references, sort them by mathematical usefulness, and explain which source should anchor the first project review.

items.review_notes: AI proposal only. Human approval is required before this content can be treated as course-ready.

proposed.title: Progress Risk Checkpoint
proposed.summary: A checkpoint prompt that asks learners to distinguish visible activity from evidence-backed project progress.
proposed.excerpt: Students inspect a progress note, identify the highest-risk gap, and justify what should be raised in the next advisor meeting.
